items.summary: 🚨❌ BREAKING | Luis Díaz could be sidelined for 4-6 weeks due to a minor muscle tear in the back of his left thigh during FC Bayern’s Champions League match against Arsenal on Wednesday evening. That is the internal expectation at FC Bayern. He could miss at least Freiburg, Magdeburg, Dortmund, Atlético Madrid, Mainz and Köln. @kerry_hau @SkySportDE 🇨🇴

items.title: 🚨❌ Official: Luis Díaz has suffered a minor muscle tear in the back of his left thigh during FC Bayern’s Champions
items.summary: 🚨❌ Official: Luis Díaz has suffered a minor muscle tear in the back of his left thigh during FC Bayern’s Champions League match against Arsenal on Wednesday evening. The 29 y/o forward will be sidelined for the time being club confirm. FC Bayern’s next six fixtures: * Freiburg (A) * Magdeburg (H) * Dortmund (H) * Atlético (A) * Mainz (A) * Köln (H)
